name: Ezekiel
summary: Ezekiel son of Buzi was a priest living with the captives at the river Chebar, in the land of the Chaldeans. There the LORD gave him visions and words to speak to His people, and even made his own life a sign to them.

key_moments.title: Sees Visions by the River Chebar
key_moments.description: Living with the captives at the river Chebar, Ezekiel saw the heavens open and was shown visions from God. Out of a whirlwind of cloud and fire came four living creatures that looked like men.

key_moments.title: Forbidden to Mourn His Wife
key_moments.description: The LORD told Ezekiel that the delight of his eyes would be taken, yet he must not mourn or weep. That evening his wife died, and he did as he was told, so that he became a sign to the people.

key_moments.title: Prophesies to Dry Bones
key_moments.description: The LORD set Ezekiel in a valley full of dry bones and told him to prophesy to them. The bones joined, flesh covered them, and breath entered them, and they stood up, a very great army.
